operating_notes.text: Installed capacity reached 13,454 MW as of March 31, 2026.
Total locked-in generation capacity stands at 32.1 GW, comprising 13.7 GW operational and 13.8 GW under construction with a 4.6 GW pipeline.
JSW Energy sold 2,50,00,000 JSW Steel shares for ₹3,150 Cr on 18 May 2026 and retains 4,50,38,350 shares.
Total installed capacity reached 13.45 GW at the end of FY2026.
JSW Energy currently operates 5,658 MW thermal capacity, with 3,200 MW under construction at Salboni and 1,800 MW brownfield expansion optionality at Mahanadi.
Consolidated gross value of related-party transactions in FY26 was ₹11,771.74 Cr.
Group entities JSW Neo Energy and O2 Power MidCo reported losses of ₹600.85 Cr and ₹177.61 Cr respectively in FY26.
Auditor noted that ₹5,426.66 Cr of short-term funds were used for long-term purposes.
JSW Energy opened its QIP with a floor price of ₹534.05 per equity share.
JSW Energy closed its QIP raising ₹4,000 Cr through the allocation of 7,61,90,476 equity shares at ₹525 per share.
Commissioned wind blade manufacturing plant at Halol, Gujarat with annual capacity of 600 MW (450 wind blades).
Installed capacity about 14.6 GW, with renewables around 61% and thermal 5.7 GW; open (merchant) capacity is under 4%.
DAM prices rose to ₹5.10/unit in Q1FY27 from about ₹4.40 in Q1FY26; API4 coal index rose to $113 from $90, up about 25%.
Wind blade plant at Halol commissioned 8 June 2026 with 450 blades a year, enough for about 600 MW of wind installations annually.

timeline.summary: JSW Energy discloses ₹1,447 Cr water demand on JMPCL, challenged in Chhattisgarh High Court
JSW Energy discloses ICRA A/Stable rating for long-term bank facilities of subsidiary JSW Green Energy Eight Limited
JSW Energy receives ₹250 Cr interim payment directive from Supreme Court in MSEDCL tariff dispute
JSW Energy discloses affirmation of IND A/Stable credit rating for subsidiary JSW Renew Energy Twenty Limited's bank facilities
JSW Energy subsidiaries challenge Himachal Pradesh land revenue demand in HC
2026-05-11: JSW Energy reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹19,878 Cr and EBITDA of ₹11,041 Cr, up 81% YoY.
JSW Energy Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹2 per equity share (20%) for FY2025-26, payable post-32nd AGM on July 9, 2026.
JSW Energy disclosed the monitoring agency report for the quarter ended 31st March 2026 regarding preferential issue proceeds utilization.
JSW Energy commissioned ~250 MW of renewable energy capacity since April 2026, lifting its total installed operational capacity to 13.7 GW.
JSW Energy divested 2.5 crore JSW Steel shares via NSE bulk deal on 18 May 2026 for ₹3,150 Cr, retaining 4,50,38,350 shares.
JSW Energy reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹4,851 Cr and EBITDA of ₹2,602 Cr, with annual EBITDA hitting a record ₹11,041 Cr.
Narmada Fintrade Private Limited, on April 3, 2026, declared no new encumbrances on JSW Energy shares beyond prior disclosures under SEBI’s 2011 takeover rules.
JSW Energy signed definitive agreements to acquire an additional stake in Toshiba JSW Power Systems for ₹150 Cr, raising its non-diluted holding to 20.7%.
JSW Energy filed its FY26 annual report, showing a 39% rise in consolidated profit to ₹2,762 Cr and a 158% jump in operating cash flow.
JSW Energy opened its qualified institutions placement with a floor price of ₹534.05 per share.
JSW Energy closed its qualified institutions placement on 25 May 2026, raising ₹4,000 Cr by issuing 7,61,90,476 equity shares at ₹525 per share.

JSW Energy received an NCLT order on 3rd June 2026 directing it to hold meetings of equity shareholders and unsecured creditors within 70 days for the scheme of arrangement with GE Power India Limited.
Urmila Kanoria declared no new encumbrances on JSW Energy shares as of April 2, 2026, beyond prior disclosures for FY2026.
Fitch Ratings affirmed the BB+/Stable rating on JSW Hydro Energy Limited’s senior secured USD bonds on 5 June 2026.
JSW Energy commissioned its Halol wind blade manufacturing plant in Gujarat with an annual capacity of 600 MW.
Care Ratings assigned CARE A+; Stable ratings to long-term bank facilities of seven O2 Renewable Energy step-down subsidiaries.

2026-10-14: JSW Energy received the certified copy of the NCLT Mumbai order dated 1 October 2026 sanctioning the GE Power India Limited demerger scheme; Effective Date and Record Date await intimation.
2026-10-24: ICRA assigned [ICRA]A(Stable)/[ICRA]A2+ ratings to the bank facilities of three step-down subsidiaries.
